abilities.description: This armed, multipurpose starship is suited for interstellar and atmospheric flight. It can comfortably transport several people, has space for cargo, and can carry and launch a single small ground vehicle—such as a speeder bike or a small land- or air-speeder. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.d602da2ce0c05f2c]{Advance}, you may spend experience to equip this module with assets.

When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.edac426b7c23f060]{Finish an Expedition} (dangerous or greater), and score a hit, this journey strengthened your ties to your ship, and any fellow travelers. You and your allies may mark 1 tick on your bonds legacy track.

When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3782f1b3c8ca8b88]{Withstand Damage}, you may roll +heart. If you do, @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-1) on a weak hit or miss.
